question: How many purchase orders are there in each status?
reference_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM proc_purchase_orders GROUP BY status

question: How many vendors do we have?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proc_vendors

question: How many POs has each vendor received?
reference_sql: SELECT v.name, COUNT(p.id) FROM proc_vendors v JOIN proc_purchase_orders p ON p.vendor_id = v.id GROUP BY v.name

question: What is the total value of POs placed with Zenith Steels in INR?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(p.total_amount) FROM proc_purchase_orders p JOIN proc_vendors v ON v.id = p.vendor_id WHERE v.name ILIKE '%Zenith%'

question: Which vendor has the highest total PO value in INR, converting USD at 88?
reference_sql: SELECT v.name FROM proc_purchase_orders p JOIN proc_vendors v ON v.id = p.vendor_id GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency = 'USD' THEN p.total_amount * 88 ELSE p.total_amount END) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many POs are in USD?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proc_purchase_orders WHERE currency = 'USD'

question: List the PO numbers that are still open, meaning placed or partially received.
reference_sql: SELECT po_number FROM proc_purchase_orders WHERE status IN ('placed', 'partial')

question: How many items are in each category? Count items without a category as Uncategorised.
reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised'), COUNT(*) FROM inv_items i LEFT JOIN inv_categories c ON c.id = i.category_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised')

question: How many active items are there?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_items WHERE status = 'active'

question: Which vendors have no payment terms on record?
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM proc_vendors WHERE payment_terms IS NULL

question: What is the total quantity issued to each issued-to target?
reference_sql: SELECT tg.name, SUM(t.quantity) FROM inv_transactions t JOIN inv_issued_to_targets tg ON tg.id = t.issued_to_id WHERE t.transaction_type = 'outbound' GROUP BY tg.name

question: How many unexpected receipts are still unresolved?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proc_unexpected_receipts WHERE resolved_po_id IS NULL

question: What is the total quantity on hand at each warehouse?
reference_sql: SELECT l.name, SUM(s.quantity) FROM inv_current_stock s JOIN inv_locations l ON l.id = s.location_id GROUP BY l.name

question: How many payment tranches are unpaid?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proc_po_payment_tranches WHERE cleared_at IS NULL

question: Which PO lines are priced in a different unit from the item's stock unit? Give PO number and item code.
reference_sql: SELECT p.po_number, i.item_code FROM proc_po_lines l JOIN proc_purchase_orders p ON p.id = l.po_id JOIN inv_items i ON i.id = l.inv_item_id WHERE l.unit <> i.unit

question: What is the average PO value in INR for INR orders?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) FROM proc_purchase_orders WHERE currency = 'INR'

question: How many stock movements of each type are there?
reference_sql: SELECT transaction_type, COUNT(*) FROM inv_transactions GROUP BY transaction_type

question: Which items have never had a stock movement?
reference_sql: SELECT i.item_code FROM inv_items i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_transactions t WHERE t.item_id = i.id)

question: What is the total quantity still pending delivery on open PO lines?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(l.quantity_ordered - l.quantity_received) FROM proc_po_lines l JOIN proc_purchase_orders p ON p.id = l.po_id WHERE p.status IN ('placed', 'partial')

question: How many purchase orders were placed in August 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proc_purchase_orders WHERE placed_on >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND placed_on < DATE '2026-09-01'

question: Which vendors are based in Chennai?
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM proc_vendors WHERE city ILIKE 'Chennai'

question: What is the total ordered quantity of item RM-MT-0001 across all POs?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(l.quantity_ordered) FROM proc_po_lines l JOIN inv_items i ON i.id = l.inv_item_id WHERE i.item_code = 'RM-MT-0001'

question: How many PO lines does each PO have? Give PO number and line count.
reference_sql: SELECT p.po_number, COUNT(l.id) FROM proc_purchase_orders p JOIN proc_po_lines l ON l.po_id = p.id GROUP BY p.po_number

question: What was the quantity variance on regularised PO lines? Give PO number and variance.
reference_sql: SELECT p.po_number, r.qty_variance FROM proc_po_line_regularisations r JOIN proc_purchase_orders p ON p.id = r.po_id

question: Which open POs have payment tranches that block dispatch and are unpaid? Give PO numbers.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.po_number FROM proc_po_payment_tranches t JOIN proc_purchase_orders p ON p.id = t.po_id WHERE t.blocks_dispatch AND t.cleared_at IS NULL AND p.status <> 'received'

question: What was the last unit price we paid for MS Tube?
reference_sql: SELECT l.unit_price FROM proc_po_lines l JOIN proc_purchase_orders p ON p.id = l.po_id JOIN inv_items i ON i.id = l.inv_item_id WHERE i.name ILIKE '%MS Tube%' ORDER BY p.placed_on DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many POs has Anand Engineering got with us?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proc_purchase_orders p JOIN proc_vendors v ON v.id = p.vendor_id WHERE v.name ILIKE '%Anand%'

question: How many items are out of stock at warehouse 132-2?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_current_stock s JOIN inv_locations l ON l.id = s.location_id WHERE l.name = '132-2' AND s.quantity <= 0

question: What is the stock of Hex Nut M8 at each warehouse?
reference_sql: SELECT l.name, s.quantity FROM inv_current_stock s JOIN inv_items i ON i.id = s.item_id JOIN inv_locations l ON l.id = s.location_id WHERE i.name ILIKE '%Hex Nut M8%'

question: How many stock transfers happened in July 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_transactions WHERE transaction_type IN ('transfer_in', 'transfer_out') AND created_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND created_at < DATE '2026-08-01'
